overview: The Industrial Infrastructure Development Scheme under the Haryana Enterprises & Employment Policy-2020 aims to develop robust industrial infrastructure by providing developed land and facilities for industrial ventures. It focuses on creating Industrial Model Townships (IMTs), Industrial Estates, and Theme Parks to support industrial growth and attract investment. The scheme is part of the state's strategy to enhance ease of doing business and promote balanced regional development through infrastructure-led geographical dispersal of industries.
objectives: Develop world-class industrial infrastructure to lower operating costs for industries
Attract indigenous and foreign investments through improved infrastructure
Support social development and generate new employment opportunities
Facilitate infrastructure-led geographical dispersal of industries to backward areas
Leverage benefits from national industrial corridors like DMIC, AKIC, and KMP
Provide developed land for industrial ventures through Industrial Model Townships (IMTs), Industrial Estates, and Theme Parks
eligibility: Eligibility is tied to the Haryana Enterprises & Employment Policy-2020 and applies to industrial units seeking to set up ventures in the state. Specific eligibility criteria for the Industrial Infrastructure Development Scheme are not detailed in the evidence, but beneficiaries are expected to comply with land allotment procedures, pollution control norms, and other clearances as advised by the Department of Industries & Commerce, Haryana.
benefits: Benefits include provision of developed land for industrial ventures, availability of world-class infrastructure leading to lower operating costs, support for attracting indigenous and foreign investments, facilitation of clearances from related government departments (Commercial Taxes, Labour, Town & Country Planning, Pollution Control Board), and promotion of ease of starting businesses through policy framework and advisory services.
financial_support: The scheme provides developed land and infrastructure support, but specific financial support quantum, type (e.g., subsidy, grant), or mechanism is not detailed in the evidence. Financial aspects are implied through infrastructure development and land provision rather than direct monetary disbursement.
application_process: 1. Approach the Department of Industries & Commerce, Haryana for advice on land availability and procedure for allotment. 2. Obtain guidance on conversion of land use and required clearances from departments such as Commercial Taxes, Labour, Town & Country Planning, and Pollution Control Board. 3. Avail incentives and concessions available to the industry. 4. Facilitate coordination with related government departments for regulatory clearances and enforcement. 5. Proceed with setting up of industries on developed land provided under the scheme.
